svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Outline, evidence map, word count per section (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake agent: config.md [D24]; the research question in full, a research report and its bibliography read [AV1, AV15], the type by the selection table [AV3]; a file given in words found by search [AQ] (stop); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, each start's brief written by the session, the choice in config.md Decisions [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (question); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: review.md and refs.bib [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, when the session runs one; the search always runs, and it does not start without a research question [J, AV15] (ruled, only when needed); The strategist, or the merge: review.md and refs.bib written with its own edits, its own query scripts allowed [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Planner: outline and evidence map, argument map with its weak-argument signs [D43, T]; the structure checked against the question and the materials [AV18] (ruled); Literature strategist, resumed or fresh: the sections that need literature and have no source [AD1, BR]; the strategist that wrote review.md [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled); Planner again: assigns what was found [AD1] (ruled); Outline approval (stop); Planner: asks what is wrong with the structure, writes 2 alternatives; your own structure is followed as user-customized [AD2] (ruled); Outline, evidence map and argument map [T] (ruled).
